tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background, nav bar, cards and form fields. Text on it is ink or muted.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Band backgrounds (hero band with the angled edge, booking call-to-action band), fact chips, selected week cards, image placeholders. Text on it is ink or muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body and heading text, links, primary button fill, accordion rules, focused and selected borders. Text on ink is white.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white or sand: asides, sub-lines, month labels, legends.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines on white: nav bottom border, footer top border, card and input borders at rest. Decorative only; it is too light to be the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Accent. The 4px left rule on pull quotes. Used sparingly, never for body text.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Highlight background for notes, discount callouts and the hot tag on a week card. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: sea-soft
tokens.usage: Pale sage tint. Background of the default tag on a week card (the site pairs it with #3f4936 text). A legacy variable name in the site's CSS.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page headline. Anybody 700 at 125% width (font-stretch: 125%). The live site still uses Calistoga at clamp(36px, 5.4vw, 58px); 50px keeps the same line length in the wider face.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings. Wide: font-stretch 125%. The live site: Calistoga, clamp(28px, 3.6vw, 40px).

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside prose and panels. Wide: font-stretch 125%.

styles.name: accordion-title
styles.sample: The Best Sleep of Your Life
styles.usage: The summary line of each accordion row. Wide: font-stretch 125%.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Pull quotes on prose pages, with a 4px sage rule on the left. Wide: font-stretch 125%.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: The price on a week card. Wide: font-stretch 125%.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: The intro paragraph under a page headline, max 760px wide.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Footer lines, notes, the picked-weeks summary.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav links. Always uppercase; the current page is underlined with a 5px offset.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Month labels above groups of week cards. Uppercase, in muted.

tokens.name: space-chip
tokens.usage: Gap between fact chips and segmented options.

tokens.name: space-grid
tokens.usage: Gap between photos in the gallery and photo grid.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Padding inside week cards and add-on cards; vertical padding of accordion rows.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right page padding inside the 1120px wrap; padding of the booking form card.

tokens.name: space-split
tokens.usage: Column gap in the two-column text and photo split.

tokens.name: space-band
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of sand bands.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. Buttons, inputs, cards, chips, tags and photos are square. The site sets border-radius: 0 on purpose.

meta.note: Display family changed from the site's Calistoga to Anybody on 2026-11-23 at the owner's choice; display sizes scaled to match.
